resume: Checkpoint context retries the same task. No automatic Codex session resume is claimed.
publication: Verified task commits may be synchronized automatically only to the pinned proposal branch by the root controller using a root-only SSH key. No force push, merge, deploy, migration or external message.

execution_model.queue_policy: Manifest task order; first task whose ID is not in checkpoint.completed.
execution_model.dependencies_enforcement: Controller checks depends_on IDs against checkpoint.completed before invoking the model; unknown/self/duplicate dependencies are invalid policy.
execution_model.per_task_scope_enforcement: Controller hashes globally allowlisted files before/after invocation and after checks; only changed content deltas count. Delta must be inside write_paths and max_changed_files. Previous unchanged dirty files are excluded; creation/deletion counts. Missing fields use compatible defaults.
execution_model.done_definition: Task verified by configured commands plus artifact hashes; no product gate, authenticated QA, publication or user acceptance inferred.
execution_model.review_independence: The independent_review role uses a new ephemeral invocation; it is not proof of a separate human, separate model or independently staffed team.
execution_model.metadata_consumption: Runner also consumes tasks[depends_on,write_paths,max_changed_files] as runtime controls. Deliverables, acceptance, estimates and recovery remain planning/reviewer contracts rather than automatic business certification.
execution_model.canonical_queue: planejamento/engineering_blocks.json on the exact manifest branch
execution_model.release_gate: CI plus required SQL/browser evidence on the exact candidate SHA; proposal_review_ready alone is insufficient
execution_model.sync_controller: Native engineering_runner verified sync: root controller commits/pushes; model/checks run as unprivileged ebt-scout; SSH key remains root-only.
execution_model.sync_failure: awaiting_sync retries the same verified commit before any new model invocation; no force push or branch broadening.

budget.estimate_kind: Technical estimate including implementation, relevant checks, review and evidence; not elapsed timer time or token usage.
budget.allocation_rule: Flow was deferred in the historical 200h plan. This authorized incremental scope must be reconciled within the existing180h; do not add15h on top, consume20h reserve as functionality, or declare other modules finished.
budget.reserve_trigger: Only evidenced defect/impediment, recorded consumption and scope impact; no automatic allocation.
budget.timebox_rule: Split unfinished task into bounded follow-up with remaining criteria; do not silently increase total or count failed checks as delivery.

block.objective: Bounded, deterministic protocol history pagination with tenant and portfolio protection.
block.baseline_policy: Read current branch+HEAD at each cycle; historical SHA is context only; never reset/clean or modify another worktree.
block.validation_track: N for cursor contract/query/security boundary adaptations; R1 cannot exempt tenant, schema, contract or storage negatives.
entry_gates: Existing Flow history source and baseline identified.
No unresolved shared security defect in affected consumer.
Assigned paths and current branch match authorized proposal.
block.release_gate: Proposal review-ready means files and synthetic evidence ready for review. Online release requires composed version, relevant SQL/browser QA, publication manifest, restore/rollback path and observed host version.
non_goals: New tenants or real client import
Auto merge/deploy or acceptance by an agent
block.concurrent_change_policy: Stop and reconcile changed remote HEAD or overlapping file edits; never force-push or overwrite work from another chat.

per_task_required: Negative scenario fixture and expected outcome
evidence_contract.version_rule: Evidence identifies exact source_commit plus snapshot/patch hashes when working tree differs from HEAD. After composition/rebase/new security changes rerun affected scenarios.
evidence_contract.command_provenance: Runner-configured checks are controller evidence. Model must not claim it executed SQL/E2E/browser from a source file or supplied expectation.
online_proof_separate: Observed public health/version and relevant page
evidence_contract.privacy: No credentials, provider raw errors, personal records, private response bodies or real client fixture.

recovery_contract.heartbeat_rule: updated_at is observation; progress_at only changes on verified task. Alive PID/lease does not prove useful progress or correct process identity.

statuses.alive: Starting process with valid lease; no completed progress inferred.
statuses.progressing: Live process and recent verified progress.
statuses.stalled: Missing process, expired lease or stale verified progress.
statuses.succeeded: Terminal task/proposal checkpoint, not whole product.
statuses.monitor_error: Unreadable/malformed/future timestamp or state failure; preserve valid prior state.

recovery_contract.same_task_retry: No session-ID resume. New ephemeral invocation uses completed IDs and current files; after failure review partial diff before retrying the same task.
recovery_contract.crash_handling: Kernel lock is released on process exit. Review last checkpoint, heartbeat, private artifacts and partial diff. Do not edit canonical completed IDs merely to advance.
recovery_contract.scope_or_checks_failure: Retain evidence; stop affected queue for explicit correction/review. Do not broaden allowlist automatically or skip checks.
recovery_contract.quota_or_auth: Remain blocked/backoff; no purchase, new key, alternate paid provider or credential copying.
recovery_contract.remote_sync_failure: Local verified evidence may exist while remote upload fails. Report local and remote SHA separately; reconcile branch without force or reset.
recovery_contract.pause: Operator PAUSE file stops future cycle; watcher only observes. No restart, notification or repair is performed by watcher.
recovery_contract.terminal_behavior: No identical review loop after proposal_review_ready. New module requires bounded manifest update and new evidence, not replaying completed IDs.

model_routing.availability_evidence: Account CLI catalog observed on VPS 2026-10-09; catalog visibility does not prove a successful model execution.
